inputs.name: LOLA LDEM_80S_40M (LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0, V2.0)
inputs.notes: label https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/lro/lro-l-lola-3-rdr-v1/lrolol_1xxx/data/lola_gdr/polar/img/ldem_80s_40m.lbl; whole product 15200x15200 px at 40 m, block-mean x4 (160 m), hillshade, Lanczos resample to 2048 px (296.9 m/px), 64 grey levels. Planar gradient (scale factor <= 1.6% at 80S ignored).

pixel_layout: row 0 = top edge (y = ymax), col 0 = left edge (x = xmin); +y = toward lon 0, +x = toward lon 90E

shading.az_reference: image-relative: clockwise from image up (+y). Cartographic light, not a real Sun position.

notes: Visual background only; no metric uses it.
